# channel_calculation

Create a reactive channel calculation backed by DCode runtime memory.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `runtime.channel_calculation` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Blocks |
| Family | Calculation |
| Monaco kind | `runtime_block` |
| Format | `channel_calculation <portal>/<channel>:` |
| Valid contexts | `file` |
| Autocomplete | `channel_calculation portal/name:<br>    return value<br>` |

## Lifecycle

Activation registers explicit and detected dependencies; dependency changes evaluate the calculation and update its target channel.

## Persistence

Calculation state survives evaluations for the active runtime object.

## Runtime-memory fingerprinting

The calculation publishes the activation source hash used to identify its loaded implementation.

## Runtime sections

- `depends_on`
- `calculation body`

## Example

```lua
channel_calculation portal/name:
    return value
```
